title: G, H, I
summary: Type paired and code-style US symbols, including backtick and tilde, with each side of a pair present.
intro: Type paired and code-style US symbols, including backtick and tilde, with each side of a pair present.

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press g to type G. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: GffG GGf fGG fGGG GG GGGf GGGG

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your left hand and press h to type H. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: HH HjH HjHH HHH jjH jH HHHH jj jjj HHHj

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your left hand and press i to type I. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: II IfII If IfI IIII III fIII

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
